agent_enrollments_scope_target.name: agent_enrollments_scope_target
agent_enrollments_scope_target.value:
("agent_enrollments"."scope" = 'personal' and "agent_enrollments"."team_id" is null and "agent_enrollments"."project_id" is null)
          or ("agent_enrollments"."scope" = 'team' and "agent_enrollments"."team_id" is not null and "agent_enrollments"."project_id" is null)
          or ("agent_enrollments"."scope" = 'project' and "agent_enrollments"."team_id" is not null and "agent_enrollments"."project_id" is not null)

knowledge_contexts_run_start.name: knowledge_contexts_run_start
knowledge_contexts_run_start.where: purpose = 'run_start' and run_id is not null

knowledge_versions_publication_shape.name: knowledge_versions_publication_shape
knowledge_versions_publication_shape.value:
("knowledge_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "knowledge_versions"."publication" is null and "knowledge_versions"."publisher_id" is null and "knowledge_versions"."published_at" is null)
          or ("knowledge_versions"."status" = 'published' and "knowledge_versions"."publication" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."publisher_id" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."published_at" is not null)

knowledge_versions_conflict_shape.name: knowledge_versions_conflict_shape
knowledge_versions_conflict_shape.value:
("knowledge_versions"."conflicts_with_version_id" is null and "knowledge_versions"."conflict_reason" is null and "knowledge_versions"."conflict_detected_at" is null)
          or ("knowledge_versions"."conflicts_with_version_id" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."conflict_reason" is not null and "knowledge_versions"."conflict_detected_at" is not null)

tokens_scope_target.name: tokens_scope_target
tokens_scope_target.value:
("tokens"."scope" = 'personal' and "tokens"."team_id" is null and "tokens"."project_id" is null)
          or ("tokens"."scope" = 'team' and "tokens"."team_id" is not null and "tokens"."project_id" is null)
          or ("tokens"."scope" = 'project' and "tokens"."team_id" is not null and "tokens"."project_id" is not null)
